title: THE ROLL HAS ITS OWN SOUND
why: His order of 2026-10-12: improve the sound and give actions a distinct noise. A roll played the thin ping the menus use to say no, a roll refused because you were too tired played the very same ping, and the landing was silent. Now a roll is a quick swell of cloth and gear with a small rattle of kit, a roll you are too tired for is a short spent breath over a low thud, and the end of the roll lands with a knock and the sound of the ground under you, stone, boards, a grate, leaves or water. Your own ears only. Sound only: nothing in the raid changes.
now: A roll now swishes, lands with a knock on the ground under you, and a roll you are too tired for sounds spent.
